description: Tells Flash Console what Claude Code is doing, and brings in the FlashTeams briefing when a session starts, over a private socket on this computer.

hooks.command: sh -c '{ set +eux; } 2>/dev/null; f=$1; shift; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; sh "$f" "$@" 2>/dev/null; exit 0' sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/flashteams-hook.sh" claude SessionStart
